title: Special forces guys play 'Hunter Skinwalker' at the ranch

tellings.quote: these three guys, the armed guys, the special forces guys that went on there and they were going to play, you know, Hunter Skinwalker

plain: Three armed men with special forces backgrounds are said to have gone onto Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch known for reports of strange happenings, ready to play "Hunter Skinwalker", that is, to go looking for whatever haunts the place. The researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this as he heard it from Brandon Fugal, who owns the ranch.
